title: TimingRecord
description: All README section 5.2 timestamps for one frame (kind FRAME, per hand null) or one committed strike (kind STRIKE), on t_mono (Phase 01 contract, Task 01.3; collected by timing; fully populated from Phase 05). Latency components (README section 5.3) are DERIVED from these fields by eval, never stored. docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.10.

strike_id.description: Set for kind STRIKE; null for FRAME.

hand_id.description: Set for kind STRIKE; null for FRAME (frame-level stamps are hand-independent).

t_tracking_done.description: Both hands' tracking finished for this frame.

t_features_done.description: Null for arms without a feature stage (Baseline A).

t_inference_done.description: Anticipator returned (rule-based or model); null for Baseline A.

t_audio_out_est.description: Software estimate from AudioEvent (measured output latency added).

t_audio_out.description: Externally MEASURED DAC output instant. Null unless an external measurement exists (Phase 18).

t_acoustic_onset.description: Externally measured (microphone) onset of the drum sound. Null unless measured (Phase 18).

t_impact_est.description: Sub-frame estimated virtual impact time from OBSERVED tip positions (README section 5.2). Null until the crossing has been observed.

t_impact_phys.description: Physical impact time from the optional practice-pad + microphone condition (ADR-0002). Null unless that condition was recorded and labelled (Phase 07).

config_hash.description: Hash of the resolved config in force (docs/reproducibility-policy.md section 3).

clock_id.description: Identity of the t_mono source (ADR-0004), e.g. 'perf_counter'.
